purpose: Intrinsic memory-operation slice (FEB-30 pattern; Toma et al., 'Beyond Downstream QA', arXiv:2610.22209, via landscape weekly 2026-10-27): fact-evolution trajectories scored against the memory STORE's operation classification — create / update / reinforce / supersede — not downstream QA. FEB-30 found the tested system's operation classification correct only 20% of the time, invisible to QA eval; this slice measures the same property for this wiki's store machinery (scripts/wiki_memory_ops_check.py). Trajectories are synthetic by construction (two fictional clubs/gardens), so the same file runs in any tree that carries the machinery. Steps labelled probe:true pin machinery behaviour outside the four classes (a re-presented superseded form must be flagged as a superseded repeat, never resurrected); live-probe lines run read-only against THIS tree's real settled corpus. A disagreement is a finding: cases are never weakened to make a run green.
